widgets_values:
Unarmed combat interaction. Realistic cinematic martial arts, 24 fps, a continuous five-second fight in a clean stone courtyard at daylight. Exactly two adult fighters: Fighter A in a dark blue training jacket stands camera-left; Fighter B in a grey jacket stands camera-right. Preserve clothing, body proportions, left-right identities and stable locations throughout. Single continuous handheld medium-wide shot, whole bodies visible; no cuts, no teleportation, no weapon, no slow motion.
[0.0-1.0s] A advances with one fast straight right punch; B visibly raises the left forearm and blocks, the strike ends at actual arm contact.
[1.0-2.1s] B immediately counters with a low kick; A shifts weight to the rear foot and checks the kick, keeping balance.
[2.1-3.2s] A pivots to B's outside and delivers a controlled hook, B bends backward to evade without changing places.
[3.2-4.4s] B clinches briefly, A breaks the grip and steps backward, both showing realistic inertia and footwork.
[4.4-5.2s] Both reset at a short distance, breathing heavily, faces and costume unchanged.
Audio: sync punch swishes, cloth movement, shoe contact, block impact and realistic breathing; no soundtrack, no narration. No subtitles, no text, no energy VFX, no limbs duplication, no camera cuts.

时长：10 秒｜画幅：保持首帧竖屏比例
以参考图作为准确首帧，制作写实电影质感的动态宣传短片。发型以参考图为准，延续黑橙配色、夜晚城市与橙色车流光轨，呈现速度感强烈的时尚科技广告。
0–3秒：静态海报自然动起来。女生保持注视镜头，轻轻眨眼，嘴角浮现自信的微笑，长发随风向画面左侧飘动。背景橙色车流光轨开始流动，暖色光线掠过她的脸颊与金属肩带。镜头缓慢推进，人物、文字和城市背景形成清晰的分层视差，原有文字保持可读。
3–6秒：音乐鼓点加速，前景“稀疏注意力”和“8步极速版”两行文字依次向下滑出画面，顶部“Minimax H3”和巨大橙色“Veda”向上移出。镜头连续绕至女生侧面，她转头望向前方，随即向前奔跑。发型与服装以参考图为准，城市灯光拉出流畅的橙色轨迹，脚步具有真实的重量感。
6–8秒：快速卡点剪辑：鞋底踏过地面的近景、肩带金属扣反射橙光的特写、女生迎风奔跑的侧面中景。最后一道橙色光轨横向扫过镜头，完成明亮利落的转场。保持同一张脸、同一套服装，人物清晰，背景呈自然运动模糊。
8–10秒：切回与首帧呼应的正面半身构图，女生停下并回头看向镜头，长发因惯性继续摆动。巨大橙色“Veda”在人物身后展开，“Minimax H3”回到顶部，白色“稀疏注意力”与橙色“8步极速版”依次随重拍落入前景。最终停留为清晰、稳定的动态海报，城市光轨仍在缓慢流动。
文字使用平滑位移、缩放和遮罩揭示，保持首帧字体风格、准确拼写与完整笔画。真实皮肤纹理，精致面部光影，橙色轮廓光，轻微胶片颗粒。配乐为节奏鲜明的电子音乐，配合风声、脚步声与字幕转场音效，无对白，无新增文字。
nodes.title: 首尾帧提示词｜描写从首帧到尾帧的连续动作

widgets_values:
Realistic live-action cinematic look, action movie trailer: practical film photography style, a post-rain dusk metropolis, anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, film grain, city volumetric fog, flying-car traffic between the towers, restrained grading for a premium feel, powerful natural movement.

Scene overview: at dusk on a cluster of skyscrapers, the protagonist is being chased, sprinting and leaping across rooftops, jumping from one building's roof to the next with pursuers closing in behind. This is the escape sequence of an action movie trailer: every leap is life-or-death, thrilling and fluid.

Storyboard (each shot a separate scene, rapid cuts, all landing on the musical beats):
[0s-1.5s] Shot 1: high side angle: the protagonist sprinting at the roof edge, pursuers appearing in the rooftop doorway behind him, wind catching his coat.
[1s-2.5s] Shot 2: the protagonist leaps across the gap between buildings, body stretching mid-air, towers and flying-car light trails behind him, a slight slow-motion feel.
[2.5s-4s] Shot 3: he lands, rolls and rises, low-angle shot, tower shadows and fog behind him, he keeps running.
[4s-5s] Shot 4: freeze: the instant he hits the edge of the next roof and launches into the jump, silhouette, holding.

Camera: each shot its own angle, cuts clean and hard, no dissolves, a slight frame jitter on the jumps.

Audio: wind, rapid footsteps, city ambience, low score underneath, an accent hit on each leap, the score bursting at 4s, closing the last 1s.

No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks of any kind, no animation or cartoon rendering, no overly-CG look, keep the live-action texture.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Fighter A, the same adult male barbarian warrior established by <Picture 1>. He is a muscular, broad-shouldered tribal warrior with tan skin, a heavy dark-brown beard, thick eyebrows, a tall brown ponytail tied with red cloth, red facial and shoulder markings, bone earrings, a necklace of large animal teeth, asymmetrical fur-and-leather shoulder armor, brown leather bracers, a red waistcloth, a bone-decorated belt and rugged fur-trimmed sandals. He carries exactly one heavy stone axe in his right hand. Its jagged grey stone head is attached to a wooden handle with leather bindings and ivory ornaments. All three views in <Picture 1> represent this single man.

<Subject 2> is Fighter B, the same adult female tribal warrior established by <Picture 2>. She is athletic and strong, with tan skin, large expressive eyes, dark eyebrows, red cheek markings, a high brown ponytail tied with red cloth, bone earrings, a tooth necklace, brown leather-and-fur armor, red fabric accents, leather wrist guards and fur-trimmed sandals. She carries exactly one long wooden spear in her right hand, fitted with a sharp grey stone tip, ivory ornaments and red bindings. All three views in <Picture 2> represent this single woman.

summary:
[reference generation] A spectacular ten-second stylized 3D fantasy melee duel between <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> inside a colorful barbarian village arena reminiscent of Clash of Clans. The male axe warrior battles the female spear warrior through rapid advances, precise weapon deflections, powerful counterattacks and a final dramatic standoff. BUNNY. The two reference pictures define character identities, costumes and weapons only. The white reference-sheet backgrounds must not appear in the target video.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the male warrior's facial structure, beard, high ponytail, red markings, muscular proportions, leather-and-fur costume, bone ornaments and single right-hand stone axe established by <Picture 1>.

<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the female warrior's distinctive face, high ponytail, red facial markings, athletic body proportions, leather-and-fur costume, red accessories and single right-hand stone-tipped spear established by <Picture 2>.

detailed_description:
A premium stylized 3D game cinematic with appealing cartoon proportions, polished character rendering, vibrant colors, smooth animation and physically readable cold-weapon combat. The environment resembles a bright fantasy barbarian village: vivid green grass, an open circular stone-paved training arena, thick wooden palisades, charming timber-and-thatch huts, red tribal banners and distant rounded rocky hills. Warm afternoon sunlight creates soft directional shadows. The scene is colorful, clean and playful rather than dark or photorealistic.

Melee weapon interaction. Exactly two fighters and exactly two weapons. One continuous cinematic tracking shot without hard cuts, teleportation or identity changes.

[Shot 1]
At the beginning, <Subject 1> stands on screen left holding his heavy stone axe, while <Subject 2> stands on screen right holding her long stone-tipped spear. They face each other across the circular arena. The camera uses a slightly low medium-wide angle, keeping both complete bodies and their weapons visible.

At 00:00.000, the male warrior stomps forward and raises his axe defensively. The female warrior lowers her stance, grips the spear shaft firmly and steps diagonally toward him. Their feet make clear contact with the stone ground.

At 00:01.600, <Subject 2> lunges forward with a direct spear thrust toward the man's upper torso. <Subject 1> shifts his weight backward and swings the broad side of his axe head across the approaching spear shaft. The weapons collide at one visible point, redirecting the spear sideways. Both fighters react naturally to the impact.

At 00:03.500, the male warrior uses the opening to advance with a powerful horizontal axe strike. The woman quickly withdraws her spear tip, plants her rear foot and turns the middle of the spear shaft across her body to intercept the axe handle. The contact halts the strike with a heavy wooden crack. The man briefly loses forward momentum while the woman bends her knees to absorb the force.

At 00:05.500, the woman pivots around his outside shoulder and uses the spear shaft to push his weapon away. The man turns with her movement, pulls back his axe and steps sideways to recover his balance. They exchange a fast but clearly readable close-range parry, maintaining consistent weapon ownership and correct hand positions.

At 00:07.500, the male warrior drives forward with one final overhead axe attack. The woman steps diagonally out of the strike path, raises her spear shaft and deflects the descending axe to her outside. The impact causes a brief recoil in both fighters' arms. The axe remains securely in the man's hand.

At 00:08.700, both warriors disengage and retreat one step. The male warrior lowers his axe into a guarded stance while the woman brings her spear diagonally across her body, pointing the stone tip toward him. The camera makes a subtle forward push, emphasizing their determined expressions and contrasting silhouettes.

End around 00:10.100 with both characters holding stable combat-ready poses in the same colorful tribal arena.

Maintain smooth stylized character animation, believable footwork, distinct attack-and-defense reactions, clear weapon contact, stable anatomy and consistent character identity. No extra characters, duplicated weapons, changing costumes, weapon swapping, floating bodies, disjointed movements, excessive particles, gunfire, blood, text, subtitles or white studio background.

overall_soundscape:
Lively fantasy tribal village ambience with gentle wind, softly moving banners, distant village activity and footsteps on stone. Heavy leather and fur movement accompanies each attack. The stone axe produces a deep impact sound, while the wooden spear produces sharp wooden contact sounds. At approximately 00:02.500, a hard stone-and-wood clash accompanies the first spear deflection. Around 00:04.500, a heavier impact accompanies the axe attack and spear block. Around 00:08.000, the final weapon collision produces a strong, satisfying combat sound. Each fighter makes short natural exertion grunts. No dialogue and no firearms.

non_diegetic_music:
Energetic and heroic fantasy battle music inspired by colorful tribal strategy games, with deep tribal drums, rhythmic percussion, playful orchestral brass and adventurous string melodies. The music builds during the weapon exchanges, emphasizes the strongest collision near the ending, then finishes with a confident heroic musical accent. Keep the physical weapon impacts clearly audible above the score.
